source_row.rationale: Recognized factors that can affect pulse oximetry accuracy include poor peripheral perfusion, nail polish (particularly darker colors), motion artifact, and certain skin pigmentation considerations (with some research indicating potential for less accurate readings in individuals with darker skin tones), requiring the nurse to consider these factors when interpreting unexpected readings.
